---
title: "metaG tool comparison"
format: html
---

## setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpmisc)
library(ltc)
```

## import data

```{r}
demic <- read_rds("cache/CBB_cache/tidy_demic.RDS") |>
  mutate(tool = "DEMIC") |>
  select(bin_name, sample_id, demic_ptr = PTR)

grid <- read_rds("cache/CBB_cache/tidy_grid.RDS") |>
  mutate(tool = "GRiD") |>
  # own_MAG = this study's bins; SMAG = external reference genomes with an
  # unrelated bin_name scheme, and would never match demic/irep bin_names anyway
  filter(genome_source == "own_MAG", trusted) |>
  select(bin_name, sample_id, grid_ptr = GRiD)

grodon <- read_rds("cache/CBB_cache/tidy_grodon.RDS") |>
  mutate(tool = "gRodon")

irep <- read_rds("cache/CBB_cache/tidy_irep.RDS") |>
  mutate(tool = "iRep") |>
  # trusted == TRUE exactly matches rows where iRep produced a value (95/95)
  filter(trusted) |>
  select(bin_name, sample_id, iRep)
```


```{r}

all_ptr <- demic |>
  full_join(grid, by = join_by(bin_name, sample_id)) |>
  full_join(irep, by = join_by(bin_name, sample_id)) |>
  # site/condition/timepoint must come from sample_id, not bin_name: the same
  # bin can be identified (and get a PTR) in samples from other conditions
  # than the one it was originally binned from
  mutate(
    site = case_when(
      str_detect(sample_id, "^J") ~ "Pasture",
      str_detect(sample_id, "^L") ~ "Grassland"
    ),
    condition = case_when(
      str_detect(sample_id, "^.R") ~ "Drought",
      str_detect(sample_id, "^.S") ~ "Control"
    ),
    timepoint = case_when(
      str_detect(sample_id, "^..P") ~ "Pre",
      .default = "Post"
    )
  ) |>
  rename(DEMIC = demic_ptr, GRiD = grid_ptr) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(iRep, GRiD, DEMIC),
    values_to = "value",
    names_to = "tool"
  )
```


```{r}
grodon |>
  filter(site != "NA") |>
  mutate(
    site = case_when(site == "JCR" ~ "Pasture", site == "LOM" ~ "Grassland")
  ) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = condition,
      y = TG_hr
    )
  ) +
  geom_point(position = position_nudge(x = -0.1), shape = 95) +
  ggdist::stat_halfeye() +
  stat_multcomp(use_label("P")) +
  facet_grid(. ~ site) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Maximum generation time (hr)",
    title = "gRodon"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


## lin reg

```{r}
pal <- ltc("dora", 3, "discrete")

ptr_plot_df <- all_ptr |>
  mutate(
    timepoint = case_when(
      timepoint == "Pre" ~ "Rewet",
      timepoint == "Post" ~ "Not Rewet"
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(value))

# n and median per (condition, timepoint) within each site x tool facet
ptr_n <- ptr_plot_df |>
  group_by(site, tool, condition, timepoint) |>
  summarize(n = n(), median = median(value), .groups = "drop")

p_all_ptr <- ptr_plot_df |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      y = paste(condition, timepoint),
      x = value,
      color = tool
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal) +
  geom_point(shape = 124, position = position_nudge(y = -0.25)) +
  ggdist::stat_halfeye(position = position_dodge()) +
  geom_text(
    data = ptr_n,
    aes(x = median, label = paste0("n=", n)),
    position = position_nudge(y = 0.30),
    size = 2.5,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_grid(site ~ tool, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(
    y = "",
    x = "PTR",
    color = ""
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "None"
  )

p_all_ptr

cowplot::save_plot(
  filename = "fig_output/ptr_comp.pdf",
  plot = p_all_ptr,
  base_height = 5,
  base_width = 7
)
```

## heatmap

```{r}
hm_pal <- ltc("heatmap0", 10, "continuous")

all_ptr |> pull(bin_name) |> unique()

all_ptr |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = paste(bin_name, site, timepoint),
      y = tool,
      fill = value
    )
  ) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = hm_pal) +
  coord_equal() + # make squares
  facet_wrap(. ~ condition, ncol = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "MAG",
    y = "",
    fill = "PTR"
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_colourbar(barheight = 0.5)) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_text(vjust = 1),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```


```{r}
all_ptr |>
  mutate(
    condition_label = factor(
      paste(site, condition, timepoint, sep = " / "),
      levels = paste(
        rep(c("Pasture", "Grassland"), each = 4),
        rep(c("Drought", "Control"), each = 2, times = 2),
        rep(c("Pre", "Post"), times = 4),
        sep = " / "
      )
    )
  ) |>
  summarise(
    value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = c(bin_name, tool, condition_label)
  ) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = bin_name,
      y = condition_label,
      fill = value
    )
  ) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = hm_pal) +
  facet_grid(tool ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Bin",
    y = "",
    fill = "PTR"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )
```


```{r}
pal3 <- ltc("dora", 3, "discrete")

# one row per bin_name x sample_id, with a column per tool (NA if that tool
# didn't report a PTR for that bin in that sample)
ptr_wide <- all_ptr |>
  select(bin_name, sample_id, tool, value) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = tool, values_from = value)

# pairwise long format, keeping only bin+sample rows where *both* tools in
# the pair reported a value, so the correlation is over matched observations
tool_pairs <- bind_rows(
  ptr_wide |>
    filter(!is.na(DEMIC), !is.na(GRiD)) |>
    transmute(
      bin_name,
      sample_id,
      pair = "DEMIC vs. GRiD",
      x = DEMIC,
      y = GRiD
    ),
  ptr_wide |>
    filter(!is.na(DEMIC), !is.na(iRep)) |>
    transmute(
      bin_name,
      sample_id,
      pair = "DEMIC vs. iRep",
      x = DEMIC,
      y = iRep
    ),
  ptr_wide |>
    filter(!is.na(GRiD), !is.na(iRep)) |>
    transmute(bin_name, sample_id, pair = "GRiD vs. iRep", x = GRiD, y = iRep)
)

p_tool_pairs <- tool_pairs |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      fill = pair,
      color = pair
    )
  ) +
  geom_abline() +
  stat_poly_line(
    method = "lm",
    se = FALSE,
    fullrange = TRUE
  ) +
  stat_poly_eq(use_label(c("eq", "R2"))) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal3) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(1, 2.5), ylim = c(1, 2.5)) +
  facet_wrap(~pair) +
  labs(x = "PTR", y = "PTR", color = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "none",
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black")
  )
p_tool_pairs

cowplot::save_plot(
  filename = "fig_output/tool_pairs.pdf",
  plot = p_tool_pairs,
  base_height = 4,
  base_width = 10
)
```

  filter(genome_source == "SMAG", trusted) |>

```{r}
all_ptr_smag <- demic |>
  full_join(grid_smag, by = join_by(bin_name, sample_id)) |>
  full_join(irep, by = join_by(bin_name, sample_id)) |>
  # site/condition/timepoint must come from sample_id, not bin_name: the same
  # bin can be identified (and get a PTR) in samples from other conditions
  # than the one it was originally binned from
  mutate(
    site = case_when(
      str_detect(sample_id, "^J") ~ "Pasture",
      str_detect(sample_id, "^L") ~ "Grassland"
    ),
    condition = case_when(
      str_detect(sample_id, "^.R") ~ "Drought",
      str_detect(sample_id, "^.S") ~ "Control"
    ),
    timepoint = case_when(
      str_detect(sample_id, "^..P") ~ "Pre",
      .default = "Post"
    )
  ) |>
  rename(DEMIC = demic_ptr, GRiD = grid_ptr) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(iRep, GRiD, DEMIC),
    values_to = "value",
    names_to = "tool"
  )
```


```{r}
all_ptr_smag |>
  filter(tool == "GRiD") |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = condition,
      y = value
    )
  ) +
  #geom_point() +

```

# gRodon


```{r}
gtdb <- read_delim("data/MAG_GTDBTK/gtdbtk.bac120.summary.tsv") |>
  bind_rows(read_delim("data/MAG_GTDBTK/gtdbtk.ar53.summary.tsv")) |>
  rename(bin_name = user_genome)
```


```{r}
grodon_tax <- grodon |>
  left_join(gtdb, by = "bin_name") |>
  # this fn takes a delimited string and separates into column names
  separate_wider_delim(
    classification,
    delim = ";",
    names = c(
      "domain",
      "phylum",
      "class",
      "order",
      "family",
      "genus",
      "species"
    ),
    too_few = "align_start"
  ) |>
  mutate(across(domain:species, ~ str_remove(., "^[a-z]__"))) # remove prefixes like "d__"
```


```{r}
grodon_tax |>
  mutate(phylum = fct_reorder(as.factor(phylum), TG_hr, .desc = TRUE)) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = phylum,
      y = TG_hr
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      transform = ~ log(2) / .,
      breaks = c(0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.5),
      name = latex2exp::TeX("CUB-predicted \nmaximum growth rate $(d^{-1})$")
    )
  ) +
  ggdist::stat_pointinterval() +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 16)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    axis.title.x = element_text(hjust = 0),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.margin = unit(c(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5), "cm")
  ) +
  labs(
    y = "CUB-predicted \nminimum doubling time (d)",
    x = "Phylum"
  )
```

```{r}
grodon_tax |>
  filter(!is.na(site)) |>
  mutate(
    site = case_when(site == "JCR" ~ "Pasture", site == "LOM" ~ "Grassland")
  ) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = condition,
      y = TG_hr
    )
  ) +
  stat_multcomp(use_label("P"), mc.cutoff.p.value = 0.1) +
  ggdist::stat_slabinterval(
    aes(fill = condition),
    slab_color = "black",
    slab_linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  facet_wrap(vars(site)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#4E80C7", "#FC9403")) +
  facet_wrap(. ~ site) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Maximum potential generation time (hr)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```
